config.label: Directory for the local white-box JSONL log
config.description: Directory for the local white-box JSONL log. Absolute path recommended. Optional; defaults to the platform log directory: %LOCALAPPDATA%\DoboCache\logs on Windows, ~/Library/Logs/DoboCache on macOS, $XDG_STATE_HOME/dobocache (fallback ~/.local/state/dobocache) on Linux.

config.label: White-box report card mode: quiet (default, no card in tool output, log only), once (one card next call, then back to quiet), always (card on every call, ~300+ tokens each)
config.description: White-box report card mode: quiet (default, no card in tool output, log only), once (one card next call, then back to quiet), always (card on every call, ~300+ tokens each). Unrecognized values fall back to quiet with a warning. Cumulative stats are always available via cf_report at no token cost.
